input: We want employees to ask questions in natural language against our policy PDFs and get cited answers.

output.rationale: Natural-language Q&A over unstructured documents with citations is a canonical RAG workload.

input: Build a public website for our annual report with downloadable PDFs and a contact form.

output.rationale: Static content with a simple form submission needs no AI; Static Web Apps + Azure Functions is sufficient.

input: An internal portal where managers approve expense reports submitted by staff, with email notifications.

output.rationale: Approval workflow with notifications is a classic CRUD + workflow scenario (Logic Apps / Power Platform / App Service).

input: Ingest call-centre recordings and produce a weekly dashboard of top customer complaints and sentiment trends.

output.rationale: Requires speech-to-text, topic extraction, and sentiment analysis over audio — all AI workloads.

input: Replace our nightly on-prem SQL job with something in Azure that copies data from 5 source systems into a warehouse.

output.rationale: Scheduled multi-source ETL into a warehouse is a Data Factory / Synapse pipeline scenario, no AI required.

input: We want a mobile app where users can scan a receipt and have the totals automatically added to their expense report.

output.rationale: Receipt scanning needs OCR / Document Intelligence to extract structured fields from images.

input: Modernise our monolith ordering system into microservices on Azure with autoscaling.

output.rationale: Application modernisation and autoscaling is an architecture migration — AKS / Container Apps — with no AI involved.

input: A platform where our analysts can ask ad-hoc questions and also browse pre-built KPI dashboards.

output.rationale: Pre-built KPI dashboards need only Power BI, but 'ask ad-hoc questions' could be NL2SQL (AI) or just guided filters (non-AI) — clarification needed.
